name: Algolaser Alpha MK2 20W
tagline: 20W Premium open-frame diode focused on speed and fine engraving detail
tldr: Algolaser Alpha MK2 20W is the 20W SKU on the Algolaser algolaser alpha mk2 line. Algolaser targets makers who want faster engraving and tighter spot control than typical budget diodes. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Versatile hobby engraving with solid cutting through typical 3–6 mm basswood

priceRange.note: 20W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

pros: Tight spot for finer detail in diode class
Fast fill engraving on optimized settings
cons: 40W optical claims need verification on your unit
Premium price vs Ortur for similar watt class
beginnerNotes: Choose 20W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Algolaser shines on line art and shallow fills — push speed on vectors after test burns. Use compressed spot advantage for photo engraving on coated wood.
primaryUse: Performance-oriented open-frame diode for detailed wood and leather engraving with above-average speed.
